summary: Theravance Biopharma filed an 8-K reporting entry into a definitive merger agreement with Zymeworks Inc. Under the terms, Zymeworks will acquire Theravance for $17.00 per share in cash plus one contingent value right (CVR) per share, representing additional cash payments contingent on future milestones. The merger values Theravance at an implied equity value based on its outstanding shares. The board of Theravance recommends the transaction. The merger is structured as a Cayman Islands statutory merger with a wholly owned subsidiary of Zymeworks. Completion is subject to shareholder approval, regulatory clearances, and customary closing conditions. The risk-arb spread will hinge on deal timing and CVR valuation.
